resume_submission_gate: submit only after the corresponding 200k source output contains checkpoint, gmm_stats, and router artifacts

controls.definition: q_route is a random row permutation of q_phi within each batch

interpretation_rules: If oracle improves over router, router approximation error is downstream-relevant.
If matched-random is similar to router, aggregate usage/confidence may matter more than input-specific routing.
If matched-random regresses strongly, the x0-to-component association carries useful information beyond batch marginals.
No conclusion is confirmatory until both new controls reach 400k and use the same repeated FID seeds as C0.
